info.title: Actinver AI Advisor - Agent API
info.description: Mobile/web-facing API of the Actinver AI Advisor (bff-mobile + agent-orchestrator + avatar-broker). Path-versioned (`/v1/`), RFC 9457 errors with a Spanish `message`, `Idempotency-Key` on every mutating endpoint, cursor pagination, SSE for chat turns and a WebSocket for the bidirectional audio path. Auth: `Authorization: DPoP <token>` plus a `DPoP` proof header (plain `Bearer` accepted in local only).

get.description: Returns 200 while the process is alive. Carries no dependency state.
Probes every dependency. Returns 503 when a fail-closed dependency (database, redis, suitability, guardrail, audit) is unreachable.

post.description: Creates or resumes the client's thread for the requested channel and returns the capabilities the app may render, the disclosures that still need acknowledgement, and mode defaults. Requires `Authorization: DPoP <token>` + `DPoP` proof (a plain Bearer token is accepted in local only).

Responds with `text/event-stream`. Events: `token`, `ui`, `form_spec`, `citations`, `error`, `done`. `done` always fires, including after `error`. Guardrail refusals (`BLOCKED_INPUT`, `BLOCKED_OUTPUT`, `NOT_ENTITLED_ADVISORY`, `NOT_ENTITLED_EXECUTION`, `PROFILE_EXPIRED`, `NO_SUITABLE_PRODUCT`, `LOW_CONFIDENCE`) arrive as in-stream `error` events with HTTP 200. See `GET /v1/docs/sse-events` for the JSON schema.

get.description: Returns turns oldest-first. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for the next page.

post.summary: Submit a Form Spec with a step-up assertion
post.description: Requires `Idempotency-Key`. The server re-verifies the spec signature and TTL, re-enters the suitability gate if the amount changed, verifies the step-up signature against the registered device key and only then places the order. Errors: `FORM_EXPIRED` 409, `FORM_SIGNATURE_INVALID` 400, `FORM_ALREADY_USED` 409, `ACK_REQUIRED` 422, `STEP_UP_REQUIRED` 401, `LIMIT_EXCEEDED` 422, `NO_SUITABLE_PRODUCT` 422.

Requires `Idempotency-Key`. The challenge is bound to `form_id` and the declared amount and expires in 120 s. Sign the raw challenge bytes with the device key (ES256, raw r||s) and send the base64url signature as `step_up_assertion`.

get.summary: Media-path reachability check before billing starts
get.description: Call before offering voice mode. `udp_available` is measured client-side and is therefore null here; `media_reachable` and `estimated_rtt_ms` are measured from the broker to the vendor. `voice_offered` folds in flags, capacity and vendor reachability.

post.description: Requires `Idempotency-Key` and the `VOICE_RECORDING` consent at its current version. Returns the LiveKit URL and a room-scoped client token only. Errors: `VOICE_CONSENT_REQUIRED` 403, `VOICE_UNAVAILABLE` 503, `AVATAR_CAPACITY` 503, `AVATAR_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED` 429, `KILL_SWITCH` 503.
Idempotent. `reason=background` applies the 30 s grace before teardown.

Requires `Idempotency-Key`. `version` must equal the current version of the document (see `GET /v1/consents`). `MODEL_IMPROVEMENT` is opt-in and off by default; it is never bundled with voice recording.

delete.description: Revoking `voice_recording` stops any active avatar session immediately; chat mode remains fully available. Revoking `model_improvement` changes nothing functionally.

get.summary: Verbatim disclosure or consent text with its version
get.description: Accepts a consent document id (`PRIVACY_NOTICE`, `SERVICES_GUIDE`, `AI_ASSISTANT`, `VOICE_RECORDING`, `MODEL_IMPROVEMENT`) or a mandatory disclosure id (`PAST_PERF`, `NO_GUARANTEE`, `COSTS`, `NOT_A_RECOMMENDATION`, ...).

Polled by the app every ``poll_interval_s``. When ``kill_switch`` is true the app hides the chat and voice entry points and shows ``kill_switch_message``. Flag state propagates in under 30 s without a deploy.

post.description: Accepts up to 200 events. Known sensitive field names are dropped server-side.

get.summary: Query the evidence index (scoped, never bulk)
get.description: Requires role `compliance`, `security` or `risk` and an `X-Reason` header. At least one of `client_id`, `thread_id` or a `since`/`until` window is required. Access is logged.
Any divergence is a security incident (control EV-02).
Returns the raw WORM record. Requires `X-Reason`; access is logged.

put.summary: Change a flag without a deploy
put.description: Authority follows the flag owner: Compliance flags → role `compliance`; `advisor.kill_switch` → `risk` (or the on-call `sre`); Product/Engineering flags → `compliance`, `risk` or `sre`. The reason is logged. Propagates in under 30 s.

post.summary: Open and fulfil a data-subject (ARCO) request
post.description: `acceso`/`portabilidad`: machine-readable JSON export written to the object store under `exports/dsr/{request_id}/` with a 90-day expiry and a presigned URL. `cancelacion`: revokes the model-improvement consent and returns the retained-data statement (evidence under DCGSI Art. 26 is retained). `rectificacion`: appends a correction note, never rewrites. `oposicion`: revokes non-necessary purposes. Every request is logged with timestamps for the 20-day SLA.

step_up_assertion.description: base64url ES256 signature over the challenge

Money.title: Money
Money.description:
Always ``{amount: decimal string, currency}`` - never a bare number
(docs/04-backend/04 §1). A value without a currency is rejected, not
defaulted to MXN (docs/07-data-governance/03 §6).

udp_available.title: Udp Available
udp_available.description: Measured client-side; the server cannot know it

challenge.title: Challenge
challenge.description: base64 nonce; sign it with the device key (ES256)

signing_input_hint.title: Signing Input Hint
signing_input_hint.default: ES256 (raw r||s, base64url) over the ASCII bytes of `challenge`

UIComponent.title: UIComponent
UIComponent.description:
Every component carries ``source`` and ``as_of`` so the client can render
staleness and an auditor can trace it (docs/07-data-governance/01 §5).
